style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, bright white daylight
subject: ONE herring in a seller apron, silver blue back, big round eye, pectoral fins used as hands
second_characters: two shrimps in visors, buyers, huge at the lens

props.jars: glass jars of orange roe, his size, hurled about
props.small: ONE tiny glass jar, three roe beads packed into it at the end
props.tag: ONE small price card marked 1499, slapped on that jar

environment: a market stall on a sunlit shallow sandbank, a dense wall of kelp and crates filling the frame to its top edge, sand and scales blowing
lighting: bright white daylight in clear turquoise water, cyan edge left, warm amber fill right
motion_rule: the camera circles the hero on the dense kelp wall and never stops, new shot size every beat, medium to close. He throws his whole body the full frame width and hurls jars off the heap every beat, mouth to the lens. The world flies INTO the lens: jars, kelp and shrimps rush at the glass every beat. The kelp wall and the stall stay behind him to the last frame. ONE hero action per beat.

audio.rate: 3.8 syllables per second, each line fits its beat
audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, speech ends by 5.75, then jars and sand carry the track
audio.lip_sync: the herring speaks on camera, mouth to the lens and opening on every syllable, nothing in it
audio.pronunciation: in-FLYA-tsi-ya, FI-cha, pri-spo-SO-bi-lis, ik-RA, te-PER, zu-BOK

timeline.a: whips his whole body round behind the stall, hurling a jar of roe into the lens; a shrimp swings its visor across the glass
swings back full width, sweeping three jars off the heap at the glass; the other shrimp drags a crate over the lens
tears a jar open with his mouth and flings it over the lens, body edge to edge; both shrimps dive under it
beats the heap of jars apart with his tail and it collapses at the lens; roe bursts across the glass
drives his mouth at the lens through the falling roe, fins full width; the shrimps shove jars back
he swings out past the same kelp wall, the tiny glass jar gripped in one fin; crates rush at the lens
a shrimp flicks one roe bead at the lens; he lunges wide and catches it in the jar
the other shrimp hurls two more beads; he dives across the frame and scoops both in, three beads rattling
he twists the lid shut and shoves the jar into the lens; both shrimps crowd in, visors bumping the glass
the taller shrimp slaps the price card onto the jar; he wheels round holding it high at the lens
he thrusts the tagged jar at the lens, three beads inside; the shrimps wave empty claws behind him

must_appear: the kelp wall and the stall behind him in every beat, never a cut to open water; at 6.45 one roe bead goes into the tiny jar, at 7.15 two more, three in all; at 7.85 he twists the lid shut; at 8.55 a shrimp slaps the price card marked 1499 on it; at 9.25 he thrusts that tagged jar at the lens
